healthRecommendations.lungDiseasePopulation: Limit outdoor time and follow your doctor's action plan. Seek care if breathing becomes difficult.
healthRecommendations.heartDiseasePopulation: Avoid strenuous activity outdoors. Seek care for chest discomfort or unusual fatigue.
healthRecommendations.athletes: Move hard training indoors or to the cleanest hours.
healthRecommendations.pregnantWomen: Reduce outdoor exposure and avoid busy roads.
healthRecommendations.children: Keep outdoor play short and move it to the cleanest daylight hours.
